interpretation: Descriptive frozen four-condition audio comparison; no listening judgments, model-based selection, or quality claim. Prior201/202 held-outs are known regression cases this iteration; fresh301-308 score-only generalization is separate.

pitch.description: Phrase-aware contour development only; previous timing allocator and no melody-flow pass.

rhythm.description: Baseline pitch writer plus the melody-flow timing pass; no phrase contour development.

combined.description: Phrase-aware contour development followed by the melody-flow timing pass.

audio_protocol.input: Same first eight-bar 4/4 chorus used for listening
audio_protocol.normalization: Linear gain to -23 integrated LUFS; no limiter; true peak <= -1 dBFS
audio_protocol.renderer: Frozen baseline renderer; no tail; full-song backing, mix, instruments and performance preserved
audio_protocol.clap: One centered ten-second window; unchanged prompt file

pitch_articulation_protocol: Count/onsets/velocity/other fields exact. Duration differences accepted only when each side independently equals min(max(before_length,after_length), its native next-same-pitch gap). Equal-start duplicate behavior mirrors reverse untangle. No synthetic note alignment or note rewriting.

pitch.description: Phrase-aware contour development only; previous timing allocator and no melody-flow pass.
pitch.source_scope: These files replace or extend baseline crates/auris-compose/src/parts; other production code unchanged. Documentation and expected test digests are excluded.

rhythm.description: Baseline pitch writer plus the melody-flow timing pass; no phrase contour development.
rhythm.source_scope: These files replace or extend baseline crates/auris-compose/src/parts; other production code unchanged. Documentation and expected test digests are excluded.

combined.description: Phrase-aware contour development followed by the melody-flow timing pass.
combined.source_scope: These files replace or extend baseline crates/auris-compose/src/parts; other production code unchanged. Documentation and expected test digests are excluded.

audiobox.capture_method: Package version and local cached snapshot hashes were captured after scoring. Native Audiobox result files do not embed the loaded checkpoint identity; these cache hashes are not an independent per-inference attestation.

clap_preprocessing.normalization: none; native CLAP clips to [-1,1] and quantizes to int16
clap_preprocessing.window_selection: equally spaced first-to-last complete window; one segment uses center
clap_preprocessing.aggregation: unweighted mean of valid excerpt cosines

baseline_score_reuse.method: Reused previously measured exact excerpt files after WAV hash verification

normalization.method: Five-millisecond edge fades, then linear gain; no limiter
